ns2:course.label: Techniques in Translation
ns2:course.description: Practical introduction in the theories and techniques of translating technical, commercial, scientific, and literary texts from English into French and vice versa. This course may be taught in English or in French; check with the instructor. Same as TRST 419. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: FR 314 or or equivalent, or consent of instructor. Same as TRST 419. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: FR 314 or consent of instructor.
